plugins.name: prisma
plugins.description: Teaches coding agents how to work with Prisma 8: edit the data contract, emit artefacts, plan and apply migrations, and write typed db.orm / db.sql queries. Use when working with @prisma/orm-postgres, @prisma/orm-sqlite, or @prisma/orm-mongo — not Prisma ORM 7 or earlier. After a version mismatch, run prisma skills sync, then check the sync output for the destination it actually wrote (e.g. .claude/skills/prisma-8, .agents/skills/prisma-8, .cursor/skills/prisma-8, .windsurf/skills/prisma-8, or .devin/skills/prisma-8) and continue from that synced project skill and its references — not this plugin copy. If no destination was written (skills.agents empty or not configured), configure one before continuing.
